verdict.rationale: Column's docs state that it automatically produces monthly statements for all open bank accounts, which covers the statement half of the story. The pack has no evidence of 1099-INT or other tax-document generation, and does not show statements being retrievable through an API endpoint. Missing for 10: 1099-INT/tax document generation, documented API retrieval of statements and tax documents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the paper obligations are automated — monthly statements generated per account, and tax documents (1099-INT) produced and retrievable through the API

citations.quote: Column automatically produces monthly statements for all open bank accounts on your platform.
